notes: Sermon. The book's title page calls these 'Sermons' ('The Overcoming Life, and Other Sermons', 1896). No text is stated. Opening words: “Some years ago a gentleman came to me and asked me which I thought was the most precious promise of all those that Christ left. I took some time to …” No text is announced. Moody opens with an anecdote, then quotes Matthew 11:28-30 ('Come unto Me, all ye that labor…') as 'one of the sweetest promises', without saying it is his text.
